translation: The two cheekbones (兩顴骨) are the large bones that rise on the two sides of the face. If injured by a fall or blow, with blue-purple swelling, hardness, and pain, the jaw tight and urgent, difficulty chewing food, bleeding from the nostrils, and the two lips turned up, internally take Zheng Gu Zi Jin Dan (正骨紫金丹), externally wash with Hai Tong Pi Tang (海桐皮湯), rinse the mouth with Bi Bo San (蓽茇散), and avoid cold places when sitting and lying. <ins>Hai Tong Pi Tang (海桐皮湯)</ins> Specially washes all injuries from falls and blows, sinew and bone misalignment, and unceasing pain.
